title: Stronger-teacher (D2 continuation) afterstate corpus: ranking gate and frozen override rule
hypothesis: The iteration-3 valid negative used a weak phase-greedy D1 continuation for its H40 labels. Regenerating the successor-closed corpus with a stronger public teacher (fair D2, five chance samples) at K=64 over the same training roots produces labels whose trained model ranks fresh held-out siblings closer to fair D4 than the D1-teacher model did (top-1 gap to D4 shrinks by at least half), and the frozen override rule then passes on fresh origins.

data.reuseDisclosure: Training: the same harvested training roots (seeds 0x5da70000-0x5da700ff) relabeled with the D2 teacher at K=64, H=40. Ranking gate: fresh seeds 0x5da70500-0x5da7053f (64 origins, D1-continuation K=256 target for cross-model comparability). Override gate: fresh seeds 0x5da70600-0x5da7063f (64 origins, same frozen rule and target as EX-20260820-d4-toptwo-override-gate-0bdb39a1).

metrics.primary: Fresh held-out top-1 accuracy vs fair D4 against the scenario-mean H40 D1-continuation target (K=256), compared with the D1-teacher model's iteration-3 result (0.4245 vs D4 0.4986).
secondary: pairwise accuracy and normalized regret vs D4
eligible-root override regret vs D4 per half-fold under the frozen rule
corpus generation wall time and work per root
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: Two deterministic held-out half-folds by origin-game hash; comparisons must hold in both halves.

passCriteria: Corpus successor-closed at K=64 with the D2 teacher; completeness 1.0.
Ranking gate: model top-1 >= (0.4245 + 0.5 * (0.4986 - 0.4245)) = 0.4616 on each half-fold, i.e. the D1-teacher gap to D4 shrinks by at least half.
Override gate: eligible-root override regret <= D4 regret - 0.01 in EACH half-fold, with override rate >= 5%.
Decisive-root label stability >= 0.5 for both evaluation corpora (else inconclusive).
gate.failureAction: Record a valid negative. If a stronger teacher does not shrink the gap, the label-quality hypothesis is weakened and the afterstate line is parked.
gate.passAction: Preregister a SCREEN gameplay experiment with the frozen override rule and the D2-teacher checkpoint.

stopConditions: Stop on any rules, information-boundary, legality, determinism, or parity failure.
Stop immediately on out-of-memory or on host available memory falling below 16 GiB.
Stop on any read of a seed outside the named lease.
Stop corpus generation after 6 hours wall.
Stop training after 3 hours GPU wall or 30 epochs.
